showcase.title: An honest CC road: every agent looks, none asks
showcase.shows: A 300 m village road, priced and sized honestly.
showcase.why: Most filings look like this one. Every check reads it and none asks: the prices are the district's, the quantities fit the road's size, nothing is sanctioned at its pin, and the first site videos show the work the agency claims. A check that stays quiet here keeps the review queue short.
later: Sanctioned 19 Jul 2026, 35 days after the recommendation
Three site videos so far: the first visit, then new work at the same viewpoints each month, the agency's claim shown
